| Area | Decision |

| Crash window | At-least-once. A retry that finds a row still `pending` resends. You prefer a rare duplicate to a missed email. |
| Postgres down before the send | Fail closed. Raise and retry. Never send without a record. |
| Mark-`sent` fails after the send | Log it and carry on. Raising would cause the duplicate we're preventing. |
| Outage tolerance | Database failures get their own retry budget: backoff capped at 60s, up to 20 attempts, about 16 minutes. Mailer failures keep the current 5 attempts. Alert on dead-letter depth. |

| SendGrid idempotency | Unverified. You'll check the docs. The plan doesn't depend on it. |
